title: Prepare an Odoo customer form
intent: Prefill one customer form from a user-supplied name and email, then leave submission to the user.
instructions: Both customer name and email address are mandatory. If either is missing, ask the user for the missing value and end the turn. Never invent either value.
Call prepare_customer_form with exactly the name and email the user supplied. It checks duplicates over a complete delegated-user scan and issues a one-turn form draft.
After a successful result, call prefill_form with no arguments. The server, not you, selects the exact route, fields and values from the current application-issued draft.
The draft is transient until submission. Stop after prefill_form; never click, submit, invoke a mutation, or claim the customer was created.
If preparation or prefill is refused, explain the short reason and do not retry unchanged input.
